items.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
items.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

items.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
items.description: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.

items.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
items.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

items.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
items.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

items.title: Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days
items.description: Crowds have gathered in Lagos to watch Ben Dancer, who says he will carry on dancing until Tuesday morning.

items.title: Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan
items.description: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.

items.title: Four bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
items.description: Rescuers are still looking for 12 Nepalese cook staff who were preparing for climbers to ascend the Himlung Himal peak.

items.title: Plan for controversial Sydney data centre scrapped after push-back
items.description: Goodman Group, the property giant behind the Project Mars data centre, says the decision is due to changes to the "policy and regulatory environment".

items.title: US prosecutors reopen case of alleged gang rape at Cornell University
items.description: It comes after the woman filed a civil lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024.

items.title: Remains of dozens of suspected kidnap victims found in Nigerian forests
items.description: Investigations are ongoing to establish the identities of at least 28 people whose remains were recovered by police.

items.title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
items.description: The category-three storm is approaching the state of Baja California Sur, on Mexico's northern Pacific coast.

items.title: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
items.description: The most revealing thing about the summit in Washington may be what the two leaders did not say - and what we still don't know.

items.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
items.description: Aleksandar Vučić's administration has been dogged by prolonged protests over allegations of corruption.

items.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
items.description: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

items.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
items.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.

items.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
items.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

items.title: Pope says 'scourge' of abuse must be rooted out as he visits Lourdes
items.description: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

items.title: Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality
items.description: The initiative would have prevented the nation from imposing sanctions unless approved by the UN.

items.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
items.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

items.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
items.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.
